question.problem:
What is the solution to the following system of inequalities?

$$
\{\begin{aligned}5x-35\ge 0 \\ 7x>21\end{aligned}
$$
question.worked_solution:
To solve the system, we need to find the values of $x$ that satisfy both $5x-35 \geq 0$ and $7x > 21$ simultaneously.

- First, we solve $5x-35 \geq 0\mathbin{:}$

$$
\begin{aligned}5x-35 & \ge 0 \\ 5x-35+35 & \ge 0+35 \\ 5x & \ge 35 \\ \frac{5x}{5} & \ge \frac{35}{5} \\ x & \ge 7\end{aligned}
$$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14194110/assets/4875553156dc3e4ec15ecdb6c848fd43d519941123d0d9763d209e9f1d6a52f6.png)

- Then, we solve $7x > 21\mathbin{:}$

$$
\begin{aligned}7x & >21 \\ \frac{7x}{7} & >\frac{21}{7} \\ x & >3\end{aligned}
$$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14194110/assets/f7a68da2d31f0bfe038252ac0dc9151d81bf854a7d33da591cbaef05f52bda28.png)

To find the values of $x$ that satisfy both inequalities, we find where the two solutions overlap:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14194110/assets/27fbd7222a4a02d4a14c17c4043b55a2828e66c2d4dcb019598ea5efef2089e6.png)

Thus, the final solution is $x \geq 7.$
